summary: CORE-01 is accepted. Validated local model removal is reviewed and published. The remote-removal candidate passes real C++ interoperability; final queue and timeout cases are being verified.

active.title: Remote model-removal services
active.detail: Working implementation serves native remove and remove/blocking protocols, preserving queued versus completed replies and final pose publication. Four C++ scenarios pass. Bounded batch, duplicate, malformed, paused/running, retained-neighbor and client-timeout tests are being finalized for independent review.

active.title: First integrated milestone checklist
active.detail: Published: Bevy/Rapier/SDF exact stepping, CLI, stable public identities/hierarchy, native clock/control/pose/IMU transport. Remaining: remote reset/remove and full initial-scene restoration; TPE; local/Fuel resources; sensor scheduling/noise; equal-work native comparison and performance report. Joints/forces and complete backends remain broader rewrite work.

accepted_slices.title: Bevy core, f64 Rapier probes and noise-free IMU

Native IMU topic repair and third real C++ scenario

remaining: Complete exact-step SDF server with clock/pose/IMU transport and a C++ comparison.
DART, MuJoCo and TPE adapters; joints, forces, complete capability contract.
Bevy rendering, asset pipeline, sensor scheduling/noise and remaining sensor families.
All 78 system migrations, native plugin ABI, full world/logging/scripting/CLI behavior.
Complete upstream parity, feature coverage, comparative performance and release qualification.

quality.note: Published local removal passed independent transport review and strict staged verification: 59 Rust and 9 gate tests; every crate exceeds 95% coverage. Hosted run pending. Remote-service measurements are separate; full reset, TPE, resources, sensor scheduling and performance remain open.
